<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at main -->

## What's Changed
* Disallow line breaks inside interpolation by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24742
* Detect managed Homebrew and delayed package feeds by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24739
* Disable all RuboCop extension suggestions by @p-linnane in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24748
* Update receipts when a redirect renames a tap by @bevanjkay in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24600
* uninstall: skip unavailable cask formula deps by @hyuraku in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24738
* info: look up installed kegs once for dependents by @HaraldNordgren in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24744
* linkage_checker: fail CI run on undeclared_deps by @cho-m in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24741
* brew.sh: reject download domains that look like options by @carlocab in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24756
* update-report: validate update revisions by @carlocab in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24757
* cleanup: keep downloads of casks named like another cask's URL by @DIYgod in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24758
* Stop recursing through tap migration loops by @hyuraku in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24761
* Load `timeout` where `Timeout` is used by @hyuraku in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24759
* Clarify brew fetch platform options by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24768
* Show why Git's version check failed by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24766
* Show download locations in verbose brew fetch by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24767
* Check cask receipts before loading tap definitions by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24765
* Keep Git cache revision checks offline by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24771
* Show curl failure output and support older curl by @iMichka in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24754
* rubocops: add audit_depends_on for iterating every matching dep by @cho-m in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24776
* Preserve API name indexes on no-op updates by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24788
* Untap with broken formulae and untrusted casks by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24781
* Prepare formula bump PRs for later publication by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24782
* Prepare cask bump PRs for later publication by @p-linnane in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24792
* Forget a tap's Git HEAD when clearing its cache by @p-linnane in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24799
* Keep failed cask upgrades retryable by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24780
* Refresh cask records after app self-updates by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24786
* style: count tap callers once across symlinks by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24779
* vulns: recognise fixes in upstream releases by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24789
* Speed up macOS tests and test-bot CI runs by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24791
* cask_loader: restore formula deps from receipt by @hyuraku in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24785
* Fix prepared bump version and branch checks by @nandahkrishna in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24794
* Test cycle and self-dependency guards in `Dependency.expand` by @hyuraku in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24801
* workflows/tests: drop unused Codecov token by @p-linnane in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24798
* Skip missing test tools under brew test-bot by @p-linnane in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24795
* dev-cmd/tests: move Sorbet ENV handling before API by @samford in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24810
* Scope download credentials to the source origin by @p-linnane in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24797
* workflows: remove Copilot setup steps by @p-linnane in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24811
* Require a CodeRabbit review for stale approvals by @p-linnane in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24812
* Load only named tap formulae from bottle JSON by @p-linnane in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24796
* Skip cask loading for qualified formula installs by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24770
* bump: support split autobump on any tap by @bevanjkay in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24800
* Use stdin for private registry headers by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24790
* Use the job token to find SBOM update PRs by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24802
* Use the job token to find SPDX update PRs by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24803
* Use the job token to find Sorbet update PRs by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24805
* Use the job token to find sponsor update PRs by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24806
* Read reviewer emails from public profiles by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24807
* Avoid redundant upgrades of self-updating casks by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24819

## New Contributors
* @DIYgod made their first contribution in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24758

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/compare/7.0.16...7.0.17
